description:
Ask for your birth chart and you get it drawn, not just described. Give a birth date, time and place, and AstroBella Astrology builds the full natal chart and a wheel you can actually explore — click any planet to see its exact degree, the sign and house it falls in, and every aspect it makes.

What you can ask for:

• Your natal chart — every placement, your rising sign and midheaven, the houses and the complete aspect list, with the wheel drawn beside it.

• What's happening right now — the transits currently touching your chart, or a scan of the coming weeks and months that shows the exact date each one peaks and how long it stays in effect.

• You and someone else — a compatibility comparison that lays out every contact between two charts, closest first.

• Quick sky questions — is Mercury retrograde, what sign is the Moon in, when is the next full moon. These need no birth details at all.

If you don't know your birth time, you still get a chart. The app tells you which parts it cannot determine without it — rising sign, midheaven and houses — instead of quietly guessing them.

Birthplaces are matched against a built-in list of over 120,000 towns and cities, so a small home town works as well as a capital. When a name is genuinely shared — Springfield, or the London in Ontario — you are asked which one you mean instead of being guessed at.

Planets are placed at their real degrees rather than rounded into a sign, and every chart is worked out fresh from astronomical data when you ask for it.

defaultPrompt: Draw my birth chart — 15 June 1990, 14:30, Nuremberg
What transits do I have over the next three months?
